svg.title: MaintenanceArena overview
svg.desc: Panel 1, the decision loop: the policy reads the condition history of a component, given as health, damage rate and deadline coordinate, exact or with sensor noise, and chooses WAIT or ORDER. WAIT lets the component operate for one more step. ORDER starts a preparation of L steps during which production continues, followed by one exchange step and six downtime steps. After a failure the exchange follows at once or the missing preparation is finished first. Revenue minus maintenance and failure costs is the reward for training. Panel 2: four source and four new degradation laws, recorded FEMTO and XJTU-SY bearing histories, the evaluation of every policy on the same lives with paired bootstrap intervals, and the reproduction of the article from the folders paper and experiments.
svg.text: After a failure: exchange at once
